newsitem.title: JAPAN: Jusco shares fall in Tokyo after news of downgrade.
newsitem.headline: Jusco shares fall in Tokyo after news of downgrade.

text.p: Shares in Jusco Co Ltd fell in Tokyo on Monday after news that Yamaichi Research Institute of Securities and Economics had downgraded the issue.
As of 0102 GMT, Jusco was down 190 yen at 3,230 yen in turnover of 73,000 shares, making it the third biggest percentage loser on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE).
Earlier, Yamaichi Research said it had downgraded Jusco to a "2" rating from its previous "1".

In its three-grade rating system, Yamaichi assigns a "2" rating to issues whose values it sees moving within 10 percentage points in either direction of the TSE's first-section TOPIX index over the next six months.
